pages.title: 5 multiblocs L8 (le plus de machines)

pages.title: MB-CYCLO (3x5x3) ⭐⭐⭐
pages.text: $(l)Cyclisateur Stellaire$(/l) -- 3x5x3, 45 blocks including the controller.$(br)$(li)Y=+3 : 5 item bus, 4 decorative casing$(/li)$(li)Y=+2 : 5 casing or hatch, 4 decorative casing$(/li)$(li)Y=+1 : 5 casing or hatch, 4 decorative casing$(/li)$(li)Y=+0 : 4 decorative casing, 4 casing or hatch$(/li)$(li)Y=-1 : 4 decorative casing, 4 fluid hatch, 1 energy hatch$(/li)$(br2)$(o)The next page shows the structure in 3D. Drag to rotate, hold shift to isolate one layer.$(/o)
